Q2: an uncertain publication uses a non-zero code with a reason without key material, never success code `0`.

- owns: `platform/mirror`, `platform/space`, `<sub>/retention`, `<sub>/alarms_retention`, `/etc/w2c/roles/<role>.env`, `/etc/w2c/tls/ca.pem`, `/etc/w2c/tls/ca.next.pem`, `/etc/w2c/tls/revoked`, `/etc/w2c/tls/crl.pem`, `/etc/w2c/tls/<role>/server.pem`, `/etc/w2c/tls/<role>/server.key`, `/etc/w2c/secrets/platform.key`, `<domain recovery file>`;

- writes: `domain/join` (create), `<sub>/<manifest:unit.rows>/<id>` (cas), `<sub>/<manifest:tables>/<name>` (cas), `door/signer` (cas), `domain/signer` (cas), `domain/signer-pending` (cas), `domain/book-seal` (cas), `domain/member-key` (cas), `domain/users/<name>` (cas), `domain/break-glass/<cluster>` (cas), `domain/keys` (create), `domain/root` (create);
- reads: `platform/manifest/<sub>`, `platform/manifest/<sub>/rev`, `/etc/w2c/configstore-rights.json`.
The envelopes `*_secret` are resealed by `cas` at the read version (the outcomes of the value — the [sealing contract](../../common/contracts/sealing.md) «Reseal a value»; `cas` and the code — here).

The form of the domain recovery file and the rules of reading it are the [domain founding contract](../../common/contracts/domain-founding.md) «Root and recovery file» (`recovery_file`, `place`, `mode`).
`common` applies to the long-lived services: all units except `w2c-workers.service` (`Type=oneshot`).
Exit 1 — a read not confirmed during `START_WAIT` (chapter 2.3) — is restarted.
A long-lived service starts through the runner (`w2c-run.sh`) with umask 0007.
`configstore.service`: the sockets come from the units `configstore-*.socket` (P/01.3 N1.3 sockets).
`w2c-controller@.service`: `WatchdogSec=360` (SHOULD).
`<dep>-<sub>worker@.service`: `n` 1 is the base one, the installation enables it; 2…99 — on order, they are started by the script of N1.5.
`<dep>-<sub>worker@.service`: the part of `%i` between `<prefix>-` and `-<n>` ≠ `SERVER_NAME` — a start refusal, code 2.
`<dep>-<sub>worker@.service`: the exec line does not get into the unit; on the stand — the command of the implementation profile with the substitution `{name}` (the common acceptance README).
`<dep>-<sub>worker@.service`: A is not in the catalogue — there is no group.
`<dep>-<sub>worker@.service`: a share from `worker.uses` — passage and connection by the group, without `ReadWritePaths`.
`<dep>-<sub>worker@.service`: `W2C_SUB_ENV=/etc/<sub>/<sub>.env` (N1.2); `EnvironmentFile=` is not used.

`<dep>-<sub>-<part>.service`: start — `w2c-run.sh part <sub> <part>` (N1.9), the runner executes\n`parts.<part>.exec` of the manifest file installed in `MANIFEST_DIR` (the installation source, P/02.3\n«Installation source»; it does not read the manifest row from the store).

`<dep>-<sub>-<part>.service`: without `W2C_ROLE`, without `roles/` and `w2c.env` — only `W2C_SUB_ENV=/etc/<sub>/<sub>.env` by\nthe grammar of N1.2, `EnvironmentFile=` is not used; the common rules of `common`.

The vectors `install-order`: the native output is one line of JSON on stdout with exit code 0: `{"result":"ok","order":[<name>…]}`, the names in the order of `manifest put`, or `{"result":"refused"}`, a refusal by the rule on an input of the form (N1.7 `refuse`).
